title: Regression with Many Generated Controls
abstract: arXiv:2611.06855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider linear regression when some covariates are endogenous, a variable sufficient to control for endogeneity exists but is latent, and the practitioner can generate many proxies for the latent control. For instance, one could cheaply but imperfectly impute the latent control using different AI/ML methods, each generating a different proxy. There are several options the practitioner might consider in this scenario: including all proxies or factors computed from the proxies as controls, instrumental variables estimation, and some nonlinear variants thereof. We use a transparent model to derive the implicit estimand each approach targets, determine when these estimands recover the parameter of interest, and provide some practical recommendations. We show that with a sufficiently rich set of generated controls, practitioners can consistently estimate the parameter of interest without relying on validation data.

translated_title: 基于大量生成控制变量的回归
translated_abstract: 我们考虑了线性回归中的如下情形：某些协变量存在内生性，虽然存在一个足以控制内生性的变量，但该变量是潜变量，而研究者可以为这个潜在控制变量生成许多代理变量。例如，可以使用不同的AI/ML方法对该潜在控制变量进行廉价但不完美的插补，每种方法生成一个不同的代理变量。在这种情形下，研究者可以考虑几种选择：将所有代理变量或从代理变量中计算出的因子作为控制变量纳入、工具变量估计法、以及这些方法的一些非线性变体。我们使用一个透明的模型推导出每种方法所针对的隐含估计对象，确定这些估计对象何时能够恢复感兴趣的参数，并提供一些实用建议。我们证明，当拥有足够丰富的生成控制变量集合时，研究者无需依赖验证数据即可一致地估计感兴趣的参数。
tldr: 该论文研究在线性回归中利用AI/ML方法生成的多个代理变量来控制潜变量内生性的问题，证明当生成的控制变量足够丰富时，无需验证数据即可一致地估计感兴趣的参数，并对各种估计方法（如纳入所有代理、因子分析、工具变量及其非线性变体）的目标估计对象进行了透明化分析。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes linear regression with latent endogeneity controls proxied by multiple AI/ML-generated variables, showing that with a sufficiently rich set of generated controls, consistent estimation of the parameter of interest is achievable without validation data.
